name: Vulnerary
lore: Bitter herbs sealed in wax. The border's whole medical doctrine in one pouch.

name: Elixir
lore: Old-kingdom apothecary work. The recipe survives; the apothecaries did not.

name: Master Seal
lore: An imperial commission, blank where the name goes. The war signs quickly.

name: Energy Drop
lore: Tastes of iron and intent. Old training-yard alchemy, one dose to a career.

name: Spirit Dust
lore: Ground from a ruined ward-stone. It settles in the blood and listens.

name: Secret Book
lore: A master's annotated footwork, sold by an estate that did not read it.

name: Speedwing
lore: Feathers from a pegasus that outflew its own rider's orders.

name: Dracoshield
lore: A scale shed by something patient. Armorers ask no questions.

name: Talisman
lore: A seer's knot worn against sorcery. It arrives already worn smooth.

name: Angelic Robe
lore: Woven in a temple the empire unroofed. The cloth still keeps its promises.

name: Swiftsoles
lore: A courier's boots, resoled past counting. The roads are in them now.

name: Infantry Seal
lore: Reassignment papers, stamped by a clerk who no longer asks why.

name: Mounted Seal
lore: Stable requisition and rank in one seal. The horse is somehow always ready.

name: Herb
lore: Fen-picked and honest. Chew, grimace, continue.

name: Remedy
lore: A field surgeon's kit in a tin: antidote, splint, and one strong opinion.
